name: Financial Invoice Data Extraction
description: Benchmarks extraction accuracy for invoice number, vendor, line items, tax rates, and totals against strict numerical and string schemas.

input_data.raw_invoice_text:
ACME CLOUD CORP
Invoice #INV-2026-8819
Date: Jan 12, 2026
Description: Virtual Private Cloud Cluster (Qty: 2) @ $450.00 = $900.00
Load Balancer Addon (Qty: 1) @ $100.00 = $100.00
Subtotal: $1000.00
VAT 10%: $100.00
Total Due: $1100.00 USD

test_cases.expected_output: {"invoice_number": "INV-2026-8819", "vendor_name": "ACME CLOUD CORP", "subtotal": 1000.0, "tax_amount": 100.0, "total_amount": 1100.0, "currency": "USD", "line_items": [{"description": "Virtual Private Cloud Cluster", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 450.0, "amount": 900.0}, {"description": "Load Balancer Addon", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 100.0, "amount": 100.0}]}
